params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridgeRepo'; $tmp=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'install-github-runner-current-main-2.ps1'; git -C $repo fetch origin main | Out-Null; $content = git -C $repo show 'origin/main:heaven-bridge/install-github-runner.ps1'; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'Unable to read installer from origin/main.' }; $content | Set-Content -LiteralPath $tmp -Encoding UTF8; try { & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $tmp; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; if($code -ne 0){ throw ('runner installer failed exit '+$code) } } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output 'RUNNER_BOOTSTRAP_OK'
